qa.title: QUESTIONS & ANSWERS
qa.subtitle: Find answers to frequently asked questions about InterPolishForces

faqs.question: How can I join InterPolishForces?
faqs.answer: To join our faction, you need to enter our Roblox server and request an invite. Contact any administrator with the required documentation.

faqs.question: What requirements do I need to meet?
faqs.answer: Requirements may vary depending on the role you want to take. Generally, you need to be active, respect the rules, and have a microphone for server communication.

faqs.question: How do I report a problem or regulation violation?
faqs.answer: You can report an issue through the ticket system on our Discord server or directly inform the administration. Provide as detailed information as possible about the incident.

faqs.question: Can I appeal a ban?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can appeal a ban by sending a formal message to the administration. Prepare an explanation of why you believe the decision was unfair.

faqs.question: What language is used on the server?
faqs.answer: We primarily use Polish and English. All members should be able to communicate in at least one of these languages at a satisfactory level.

faqs.question: Is there a minimum age requirement?
faqs.answer: While we don't have a strictly defined minimum age requirement, we recommend that members be at least 13 years old and demonstrate maturity.

faqs.question: How do I get promoted to a higher rank?
faqs.answer: Promotion depends on your activity, engagement, and demonstrated skills. The administration will observe your progress and consider promotion at the appropriate time.

faqs.question: Can I become a moderator or administrator?
faqs.answer: Yes, this is possible. You need to demonstrate appropriate skills, trustworthiness, and be an active team member. The right person from administration should propose you.

about.title: WHAT IS IPF?
about.subtitle: Learn about our history, mission, and how to join our community
about.whoAreWeContent: InterPolishForces is a dynamic and professional military organization operating on the Roblox server. We are committed to creating a friendly, disciplined, and engaged community of players.
about.whoAreWeContent2: Our members come from different parts of the world, but we are united by a common passion for gaming and an interest in military matters. We create an environment where everyone can develop and achieve their goals.
about.ourMissionContent: The mission of InterPolishForces is to build a strong, organized, and mutually respectful community of players. We strive to:
about.mission1: Provide a positive experience on the server
about.mission2: Support new members in their development
about.mission3: Organize events and operations for the entire faction
about.mission4: Maintain high standards of professionalism and ethics
about.mission5: Create a friendly and safe environment for players
about.valuesIntro: Shadow Abyssal X's activities are based on the following fundamental values:
about.value1Content: - We respect every member of our community regardless of their position.
about.value2Content: - We believe that discipline is the key to success and harmony in a group.
about.value3Content: - We work together for the common good and support each other.
about.value4Content: - We communicate openly and honestly with our members.
about.value5Content: - Every member is engaged in the activities of InterPolishForces.
about.structureContent: InterPolishForces has a well-defined structure with various roles and positions. From Faction Command at the top to Trial Moderators, every role is important and supports the overall functioning of the organization.
about.structureContent2: To learn more about our roles and staff members, visit the 'Staff' page.
about.howToJoinContent: If you are interested in joining InterPolishForces, here are the basic steps:
about.step1: Enter our Roblox server and familiarize yourself with our regulations
about.step2: Join our Discord server to stay in touch with the community
about.step3: Contact an administration member to request an invite to the faction
about.step4: Go through the verification process and meet the other members
about.step5: Start a new adventure with InterPolishForces!
about.contactContent: If you have questions or want to contact the administration, you can do so via:
about.contactRoblox: Roblox: Direct message to an administration member
about.contactWebsite: This website: Use the contact option (if available)

regulations.title: Regulations of InterPolishForces Server
regulations.warning: Anyone who breaks rules will face consequences, such as being muted for a certain number of hours, banned, or kicked off server. If you give out someone else's personal information, you can expect to receive a permanent ban and be added to ⁠𝙺𝙾𝚂.
regulations.highlight: Some rules will be highlighted to avoid breaking any regulations and ending up on the kos-list.
regulations.voiceChatRulesTitle: Section 2: General rules in voice chat

general: Respect others: Behave respectfully toward all members of server, regardless of their age, gender, background or views.
Do not insult higher ranks, because there will be consequences. <-- This applies to both administrators and members.
Do not insult whole administration and others as well as each other. <-- This applies to both administrators and members.
Do not report faction members without a reason (in Roblox).
Do not use offensive language: Avoid vulgarities, offensive words, hate speech and discriminatory statements.
Don't spam: Don't send excessive messages, share unnecessary links or use capital letters unnecessarily.
Don't share personal information: Don't share information that could identify you or other users, such as phone number, email address or bank details.
Don't share NSFW content: Do not share sexual, violent or offensive content.
Don't advertise: Don't advertise your products, services or other websites without permission from administrators.
Don't share copyrighted content: Don't share content that infringes on the copyrights of others.
Don't impersonate others: Do not impersonate other users or administrators.
voice: Respect others: Be respectful to all members of server, regardless of their age, gender, background, or views.
Do not use offensive language: Avoid profanity, offensive words, hate speech, and discriminatory statements.
Do not shout: Speak calmly and clearly so that everyone can hear you well.
Do not spam with sounds: Do not continuously play music, sounds, or other recordings without the consent of others.
Do not interrupt conversations: If someone is speaking, wait for your turn to speak.
Don't use microphone unnecessarily: If you don't want to participate in the conversation, turn off your microphone.
Don't play NSFW content: Don't play sexual, violent, or offensive content.
Don't interrupt someone before they have finished speaking.
Do not record conversations without consent: Do not record conversations without the consent of all participants.
Do not record a conversation without another person's consent.
inGame: No flaming: Do not engage in quarrels or attack other players in-game.
No rule bypassing: Follow the rules of the server in-game and follow orders from higher ranks.
Teamwork: Work together with team members for common goals.
No cheating: Using exploits, scripts, or any form of cheating is strictly forbidden.
No griefing: Do not destroy buildings or interfere with other players.
Respect rank: Listen to orders from members with higher rank.
Safe play: Do not enter dangerous areas without permission from administration.
Activity: Be active and engaged in server activities.

log1.desc: High-intensity urban warfare in Cyber City Delta. Enemy attempts to flank were neutralized by our vanguard units.
log1.details: Our squad utilized verticality to gain advantage. MVP 'Commander Shepard' secured vital checkpoints efficiently.

log2.desc: Defensive blockade at Wasteland Outpost. Despite heavy resistance, the Iron Legion breached our perimeter capabilities.
log2.details: Failure in sector 7 communication relays led to tactical disadvantage. Regrouping required for counter-measures.

log3.desc: A stalemate conflict in the Data Center Core. Both sides exhausted resources without gaining significant ground.
log3.details: Attrition rates were within acceptable limits. Intelligence gathering was successful despite the draw.

log4.desc: Total dominance in Orbital Station. The Cybernetic Front was unprepared for our zero-g tactics.
log4.details: Flawless execution by all units. 300-0 score reflects absolute control over the objective points.
